9: 
10: /-!
11: # Integration with respect to a finite product of measures
12: 
13: On a finite product of measure spaces, we show that a product of integrable functions each
14: depending on a single coordinate is integrable, in `MeasureTheory.integrable_fintype_prod`, and
15: that its integral is the product of the individual integrals,
16: in `MeasureTheory.integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod`.
17: -/
18: 
19: public section
20: 
21: open Fintype MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.Measure
22: 
23: namespace MeasureTheory
24: 
25: variable {𝕜 ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
26: 
27: namespace Integrable
28: 
29: variable [NormedCommRing 𝕜]
30: 
31: /-- On a finite product space in `n` variables, for a natural number `n`, a product of integrable
32: functions depending on each coordinate is integrable. -/
33: theorem fin_nat_prod {n : ℕ} {E : Fin n → Type*}
34:     {mE : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)} {μ : (i : Fin n) → Measure (E i)} [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)]
35:     {f : (i : Fin n) → E i → 𝕜} (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i) (μ i)) :
36:     Integrable (fun (x : (i : Fin n) → E i) ↦ ∏ i, f i (x i)) (Measure.pi μ) := by
37:   induction n with
38:   | zero => simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.prod_empty, isFiniteMeasure_iff,
39:       integrable_const_iff, pi_empty_univ, ENNReal.one_lt_top, or_true]
40:   | succ n n_ih =>
41:       have := ((measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove μ 0).symm)
42:       rw [← this.integrable_comp_emb (MeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding _)]
43:       simp_rw [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv,
44:         Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.insertNth_zero]
45:       simp only [Fin.zero_succAbove, cast_eq, Function.comp_def]
46:       have : Integrable (fun (x : (j : Fin n) → E (Fin.succ j)) ↦ ∏ j, f (Fin.succ j) (x j))
47:           (Measure.pi (fun i ↦ μ i.succ)) :=
48:         n_ih (fun i ↦ hf _)
49:       exact Integrable.mul_prod (hf 0) this
50: 
51: /-- On a finite product space, a product of integrable functions depending on each coordinate is
52: integrable. Version with dependent target. -/
53: theorem fintype_prod_dep {E : ι → Type*}
54:     {f : (i : ι) → E i → 𝕜} {mE : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)} {μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)}
55:     [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)]
56:     (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i) (μ i)) :
57:     Integrable (fun (x : (i : ι) → E i) ↦ ∏ i, f i (x i)) (Measure.pi μ) := by
58:   let e := (equivFin ι).symm
59:   simp_rw [← (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft _ e).integrable_comp_emb
60:     (MeasurableEquiv.measurableEmbedding _),
61:     ← e.prod_comp, MeasurableEquiv.coe_piCongrLeft, Function.comp_def,
62:     Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply]
63:   exact .fin_nat_prod (fun i ↦ hf _)
64: 
65: /-- On a finite product space, a product of integrable functions depending on each coordinate is
66: integrable. -/
67: theorem fintype_prod {E : Type*}
68:     {f : ι → E → 𝕜} {mE : MeasurableSpace E} {μ : ι → Measure E} [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)]
69:     (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i) (μ i)) :
70:     Integrable (fun (x : ι → E) ↦ ∏ i, f i (x i)) (Measure.pi μ) :=
71:   Integrable.fintype_prod_dep hf
72: 
73: end Integrable
74: 
75: variable [RCLike 𝕜]
76: 
77: set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
78: /-- A version of **Fubini's theorem** in `n` variables, for a natural number `n`. -/
79: theorem integral_fin_nat_prod_eq_prod {n : ℕ} {E : Fin n → Type*}
80:     {mE : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)} {μ : (i : Fin n) → Measure (E i)} [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)]
81:     (f : (i : Fin n) → E i → 𝕜) :
82:     ∫ x : (i : Fin n) → E i, ∏ i, f i (x i) ∂(Measure.pi μ) = ∏ i, ∫ x, f i x ∂(μ i) := by
83:   induction n with
84:   | zero => simp [measureReal_def]
85:   | succ n n_ih =>
86:       calc
87:         _ = ∫ x : E 0 × ((i : Fin n) → E (Fin.succ i)),
88:             f 0 x.1 * ∏ i : Fin n, f (Fin.succ i) (x.2 i)
89:             ∂((μ 0).prod (Measure.pi (fun i ↦ μ i.succ))) := by
90:           rw [← ((measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove μ 0).symm).integral_comp']
91:           simp_rw [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv,
92:             Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.insertNth_zero, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Fin.cons_succ,
93:             Fin.zero_succAbove, cast_eq, Fin.cons_zero]
94:         _ = (∫ x, f 0 x ∂μ 0)
95:             * ∏ i : Fin n, ∫ (x : E (Fin.succ i)), f (Fin.succ i) x ∂(μ i.succ) := by
96:           rw [← n_ih, ← integral_prod_mul]
97:         _ = ∏ i, ∫ x, f i x ∂(μ i) := by rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
98: 
99: /-- A version of **Fubini's theorem** in `n` variables, for a natural number `n`. -/
100: theorem integral_fin_nat_prod_volume_eq_prod {n : ℕ} {E : Fin n → Type*}
101:     [∀ i, MeasureSpace (E i)] [∀ i, SigmaFinite (volume : Measure (E i))]
102:     (f : (i : Fin n) → E i → 𝕜) :
103:     ∫ x : (i : Fin n) → E i, ∏ i, f i (x i) = ∏ i, ∫ x, f i x := integral_fin_nat_prod_eq_prod _
104: 
105: /-- A version of **Fubini's theorem** with the variables indexed by a general finite type. -/
106: theorem integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod {E : ι → Type*} (f : (i : ι) → E i → 𝕜)
107:     {mE : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (E i)} {μ : (i : ι) → Measure (E i)} [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)] :
108:     ∫ x : (i : ι) → E i, ∏ i, f i (x i) ∂(Measure.pi μ) = ∏ i, ∫ x, f i x ∂(μ i) := by
109:   let e := (equivFin ι).symm
110:   rw [← (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft _ e).integral_comp']
111:   simp_rw [← e.prod_comp, MeasurableEquiv.coe_piCongrLeft, Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply,
112:     MeasureTheory.integral_fin_nat_prod_eq_prod]
113: 
114: /-- A version of **Fubini's theorem** with the variables indexed by a general finite type. -/
115: theorem integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_prod {E : ι → Type*} (f : (i : ι) → E i → 𝕜)
116:     [∀ i, MeasureSpace (E i)] [∀ i, SigmaFinite (volume : Measure (E i))] :
117:     ∫ x : (i : ι) → E i, ∏ i, f i (x i) = ∏ i, ∫ x, f i x := integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod _
118: 
119: theorem integral_fintype_prod_eq_pow {E : Type*} (f : E → 𝕜) {mE : MeasurableSpace E}
120:     {μ : Measure E} [SigmaFinite μ] :
121:     ∫ x : ι → E, ∏ i, f (x i) ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ ↦ μ)) = (∫ x, f x ∂μ) ^ (card ι) := by
122:   rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod, Finset.prod_const, card]
123: 
124: theorem integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_pow {E : Type*} (f : E → 𝕜)
125:     [MeasureSpace E] [SigmaFinite (volume : Measure E)] :
126:     ∫ x : ι → E, ∏ i, f (x i) = (∫ x, f x) ^ (card ι) := integral_fintype_prod_eq_pow _
127: 
128: variable {X : ι → Type*} {mX : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (X i)} {μ : (i : ι) → Measure (X i)}
129:     {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
130: 
131: lemma integrable_comp_eval [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)] {i : ι} {f : X i → E}
132:     (hf : Integrable f (μ i)) :
133:     Integrable (fun x ↦ f (x i)) (Measure.pi μ) := by
134:   refine Integrable.comp_measurable ?_ (by fun_prop)
135:   classical
136:   rw [Measure.pi_map_eval]
137:   exact hf.smul_measure <| ENNReal.prod_ne_top (by finiteness)
138: 
139: lemma integrable_eval [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (X i)] [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (μ i)] {i : ι}
140:     (h : Integrable id (μ i)) :
141:     Integrable (fun x ↦ x i) (Measure.pi μ) :=
142:   integrable_comp_eval h
143: 
144: lemma integral_comp_eval [NormedSpace ℝ E] [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)] {i : ι} {f : X i → E}
145:     (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ i)) :
146:     ∫ x : Π i, X i, f (x i) ∂Measure.pi μ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ i := by
147:   rw [← (measurePreserving_eval μ i).map_eq, integral_map]
148:   · exact Measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)
149:   · rwa [(measurePreserving_eval μ i).map_eq]
150:

660: end Measure

662: theorem volume_pi [∀ i, MeasureSpace (α i)] :
663:     (volume : Measure (∀ i, α i)) = Measure.pi fun _ => volume :=
664:   rfl

e ⁻¹' WaveMap.box (k+1) R = Icc (-R) R ×ˢ (Set.univ.pi (fun _ : Fin k => Icc (-R) R)) := by
  intro k j R e
  ext p
  rcases p with ⟨r,y⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, forall_const]
  change (∀ i, Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) j r y i ∈ Icc (-R) R) ↔

  (volume.restrict (WaveMap.box (k+1) R)) at hres
